revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - The correction of κάτοικος in l. 6 into κατοίκικας proposed by Rowlandson is correct
General - Having checked the relevant Canducci articles I regard it as being quite correct to expand to κατοικ(ικὰς).
Vote - DEFER - Defer. Seems reasonable enough to me. Is this clear enough? Same at P.Bour. 37 passim? Next voter?

Concerning line 6 of this papyrus, Jane Rowlandson writes in an email dated 15.04.13: "BGU 2.487 should be expanded κατοικ(ικὰς) with arouras, not κάτοικ(ος) with Theano." Rowlandson argues that a land category is always required before ἄρουραι. She also notes that this text is not included in Canducci’s (1990, 1991) list of the 6475 Arsinoite Hellenes/katoikoi and adds that Canducci "evidently already realised the correct interpretation."
